answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 5 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The reef chain is verified at intake and haven publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 5 epochs old, anchored at a saffron checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 379 aliases cost 350 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
